hook: Meta could be crippled by a $25 billion privacy penalty.

sections.voiceover: Meta could be crippled by a $25 billion privacy penalty.
In September 2026, a New Mexico jury found Meta liable for 43 million privacy violations. Will the $25 billion penalty dwarf Meta’s $18 billion child‑safety settlement?
But the state said it was entitled to the full $219.49 billion.

The $25 billion judgment is the largest U.S. tech‑company penalty. It eclipses Meta’s earlier $18 billion child‑safety settlement from August 2026. Meta now owes New Mexico $25 billion, reshaping data‑privacy enforcement.
The $25 billion verdict stands as the record penalty.
